description: Boundary pair for the 50% overlap fraction: two thin strips above the same line, identical except width, straddling its left edge. Overlap exactly 50% of the small long side still counts (>=); 44% does not. Added after a perturbation probe (OVERLAP_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.99) showed the fully-contained seed pairs could not feel the overlap rule at all.

pairs.name: strip overlapping exactly half its width
